text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval from Etobicoke York Community Council to introduce overnight on-street permit parking on Thirty Third Street, between Dominion Road and Park Boulevard, on a street name basis, under the operating hours of 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., seven days a week. Area residents requested the implementation of overnight on-street permit parking on Thirty Third Street, between Dominion Road and Park Boulevard to accommodate their long term parking needs without being subject to tagging by Parking Enforcement Officers.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Approved the amendment of Schedule A of City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 925, Permit Parking, to incorporate Thirty Third Street, between Dominion Road and Park Boulevard, on a street name basis, under the operating hours of 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., seven days a week. 2. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect from 8:00 a.m to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on Thirty Third Street between Dominion Road and Park Boulevard.
